localFacts.fact: Canon Deutschland lists the EOS R50 (black) at approx. 328 g body only and 375 g with battery and card (CIPA): the same 375 g as the English post, from the German spec page.
Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg; all four full-size picks (Element MII 42,5 cm, Peak Design 39,4 cm, Befree Advanced 40 cm, K&F 39 cm folded) are shorter than 55 cm.
Kölner Dom (Domordnung): private photos without flash are allowed, but recordings with tripods need permission from the Dompropst.
Humboldt Forum Berlin allows private photos, but tripods may not be used indoors.
German terms: Stativkopf, Kugelkopf, Mittelsäule, Schnellwechselplatte, Stativgewinde 1/4 Zoll; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Thin travel-tripod legs start to vibrate in light wind, so the maker's load rating says little.
localPainPoints.fix: The English post's point: the R50 kit is ~505 g, so choose on legs and column-down height; keep the column down and hang the bag on the hook (Element MII, K&F).

quotes.text: Noch ein Tipp: Orientiere dich nicht an der Tragfähigkeit, die der Hersteller angibt.
Reisestative mit diesen dünnen Beinchen brechen nicht unter deiner Kamera zusammen. Aber sie fangen schon bei leichtem Wind an zu schwingen

localPainPoints.pain: Light tripods tip over in wind without extra weight.
localPainPoints.fix: Hang the bag from the hook under the column (Element MII has one; K&F has a small hook), spread the legs wide.

quotes.text: ich habe schon einige umgekippte Stative (samt Kamera und Optik) gesehen, die ohne Zusatzgewichte, bei gar nicht starkem Wind, sich verselbstständigt haben.

localPainPoints.pain: Unsure whether a tripod goes in cabin baggage on a European flight.
localPainPoints.fix: All four full-size picks fold to 39-42,5 cm, under Lufthansa's 55 cm cabin-bag length.

localGain.point: Lufthansa 55 x 40 x 23 cm cabin-bag check for all four full-size picks.
Venue rules (Kölner Dom permit, Humboldt Forum no tripods indoors): where the GorillaPod or no tripod at all is the realistic option.
Maker metric figures (132 cm column down, 42,5 cm folded for the Element MII; EU code MKBFRLA4BK-BH for the Befree Advanced) and the R50 weight from Canon Deutschland.
